description: Delete all hybrid bolt elements and associated dowels in the range. Structure nodes and links that become disconnected from any element will automatically be deleted as well.
verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/common/sel/doc/manual/sel_manual/hybrid/commands/cmd_structurehybrid.delete.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
